what: independent line-by-line verification of the project brief against the committed implementation and captures; every value recomputed with code written for this audit

checks.requirement: Pin home-court advantage to the measured home-win rate instead of fitting it freely.
checks.what_i_recomputed: home-win rate 99/188 = 0.526596; sample sd of margins 16.898969; HCA = logit(p)*sd = 1.799461 points
checks.method_note: independent recompute from data/origin/games.csv (the same finals log the model reads), with my own mean/sd/logit code

checks.requirement: Keep two independent estimators and publish their disagreement as the primary confidence signal.
checks.what_i_recomputed: ridge margin fit (lam=8, HCA=1.7995 pinned and subtracted) on 188 finals with an independent Gauss-Seidel solver; predicted all 22 slate margins
checks.method_note: tolerance 1e-3 points; solver differs on purpose (Gauss-Seidel vs elimination)

checks.requirement: Model the total as possessions x points-per-possession, not as an average of team scoring averages.
checks.what_i_recomputed: possessions = mean of the two teams' PACE; PPP = PTS*GP/POSS from the official team pages; total = poss * (PPP_home + PPP_away) for all 21 slate games with complete inputs
checks.method_note: inputs read from data/v2/captures/official_team_statistics_2026-11-15.json (the three official team-stat pages: traditional, opponent, advanced)

checks.area: luck z-scores and the noise band
checks.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per team and refuse to publish a strategy that leans on a team outside the noise band.
checks.what_i_recomputed: per-team z of residual wins vs the pinned-HCA rating, my own solver and my own norm_cdf, over 188 finals
checks.band_standardization: z set re-standardized before the band: mean -0.0815, sd 1.4160, k=2
checks.method_note: band |z| > 2 = outside the noise band; the leaderboard gate is checked in V-GATES

checks.requirement: Determine correlation values ... price every parlay with the measured rho.
checks.what_i_recomputed: Pearson r + Fisher z 95% CI on the finals log, my own code

rows.pair: home points vs away points, same game
final margin vs final total, same game

checks.requirement: Price every parlay with the measured rho and print the naive product next to it, instead of withholding the price entirely.
checks.what_i_recomputed: same-game parlay joint probability at the measured rho (-0.018214) by conditional-normal Gauss-Legendre quadrature; naive product p_side*p_total beside it
checks.method_note: tolerance 3e-3 on the copula: the audited code uses a 2000-step midpoint average, this audit uses 96-node Gauss-Legendre; the two quadratures should agree far tighter than any decision they feed

checks.requirement: Compute rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 from the official schedule and add travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table.
checks.what_i_recomputed: 22 slate games x both sides: rest days and 3-in-4 from the finals log + official schedule, travel = haversine(previous venue, tonight's venue) from the arena table
checks.method_note: my own haversine (6371.0 km radius), compared at 0.15 km tolerance

checks.requirement: Add travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table.
checks.what_i_recomputed: all 30 arena coordinates re-read from the Wikipedia GeoData API on 2026-11-19 (the exact source the table cites) and compared
checks.method_note: tier stays SECONDARY (Wikipedia) as the table declares — coordinates are a geographic fact, not an NBA statistic; the NBA schedule supplies venue names

checks.requirement: Freeze a pre-registration file per strategy before its first bet: signal, thresholds, universe, and the exact settlement rule.
checks.what_i_recomputed: sha256 over each frozen payload (sorted-key compact JSON), field presence
checks.method_note: settlement_rule_text must name the official final as the settling source

checks.requirement: Add a tamper-evident ledger: hash each published pick, publish the hash before tip, and verify after settlement.
checks.what_i_recomputed: 13 entries: sha256 of each pick/payload, each entry_hash = sha256(prev || body), chain linkage, head vs index

checks.requirement: Settle the sealed ledger from official finals as soon as each game day ends, and keep the settlement stamp visible.
checks.what_i_recomputed: 43 entries: payload sha256 + entry chain + settlement stamps
settlement_stamps_sample: settled at 2026-11-16T18:36Z (game day end, 2026-11-15) from the official final IND 124 - PHI 131; quarter sums == finals (4 periods, verified)
settled at 2026-11-16T18:36Z (game day end, 2026-11-15) from the official final LAL 131 - PHX 123; quarter sums == finals (4 periods, verified)
settled at 2026-11-16T18:36Z (game day end, 2026-11-15) from the official final CHA 105 - LAC 113; quarter sums == finals (4 periods, verified)

checks.requirement: Model minutes redistribution explicitly: for each team, the top-8 minutes shares and the replacement shares when a player is out.
checks.what_i_recomputed: top-8 share sums and replacement shares read and re-added from the published minutes model for 30 teams
checks.status: verified for every team with captured minutes; teams without a capture publish no shares rather than guessed ones
checks.method_note: the underlying player-minutes capture covers only the teams its capture step reached (see V-PLAYERLOGS); uncovered teams publish nothing rather than a guessed share — listed in the rows as top8_share_available=false

checks.requirement: Keep an official per-game result feed current and settle only after final scores are verified; store one row per game: date, teams, final score, quarter scores.
checks.what_i_recomputed: 48 rows: required-field presence, quarter-score completeness, settlement stamps
checks.status: verified (quarters blank + flagged where not captured)
checks.method_note: quarter scores are null on every row this feed carries and each such row says 'quarter scores not captured — blank, flagged'; values were not inferred

checks.area: per-player game logs for injured players
checks.requirement: Capture per-player game logs (minutes, points, rebounds, assists, and the opponent) for at least the players who appear on an injury report.
checks.what_i_recomputed: 84 player names parsed from the newest captured official injury report vs 108 names in the captured game logs / player-minutes tables; matched on (last, first-initial)
checks.status: PARTIAL — gap listed, not filled with guesses
checks.method_note: game logs exist for the 2026-11-15 captured game books (8 club-games) and the player-minutes tables for the teams their capture reached; the rest is a documented gap, not a fabricated row

checks.requirement: Add a market-anchored prior: blend the model line with the closing line, weight by measured out-of-sample log-loss.
checks.what_i_recomputed: presence and wiring of the blend function; whether any closing line exists in the committed inputs
checks.status: DEFINED, NOT APPLIED — blocked on a licensed closing-line feed (documented, no weight invented)
checks.method_note: pipeline/v2/strategies.py states the blend w x model + (1-w) x closing with w from measured OOS log-loss; with no closing line in the repository the caller passes nothing and the market-free price is published instead

checks.area: validation gates, luck refusal, headline choice
checks.requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates ... refuse to publish a strategy that leans on a team outside the noise band ... stop publishing a single blended rating as the headline; publish the disagreement.
checks.what_i_recomputed: board gate grid + the published projection surface: is the estimator disagreement presented as the headline confidence signal?

flags.flag: the hosted scheduled refresh is red and has not fetched official data since 2026-11-17
flags.detail: scheduled runs fail at the committed-tree unit-test preflight (latest evidence run 44469939831: test_committed_round_captures_replay_before_the_live_fetch, subTest gamebooks_2ecbccfd.py). Owner session arena/915d2e99-nba3 is on it (PR #143). This audit does not touch that code.

flags.flag: the canonical published results feed is behind the committed captures
flags.detail: data/app/results_feed.json carries 23 settled rows through 2026-11-15 while captures for 2026-11-16..18 finals exist under data/rounds/ (dd3edd74 + b1ce1334 trees). Integration request CR-DD3-01 on the board covers the fold-in; this audit records the gap and does not rewrite published data.

flags.flag: player-minutes capture covers only part of the league
flags.detail: official_player_minutes_2026-11-15.json covers the teams its capture step reached and names the rest in not_captured_teams; minutes redistribution therefore publishes for captured teams only. Not filled with estimates.

flags.flag: quarter scores are absent from every settled result row
flags.detail: each row says 'quarter scores not captured — blank, flagged'; the brief's row shape (date, teams, final, quarter scores) is met structurally with the quarter cells null rather than invented.

flags.flag: no closing line / odds feed exists, so the market-anchored prior cannot be applied
flags.detail: the blend is defined in pipeline/v2/strategies.py with weight from measured out-of-sample log-loss, but with no licensed closing line connected there is nothing to blend with; the site publishes the market-free price and says so.

flags.flag: estimator B's historical error figure is contaminated by a single dated snapshot
flags.detail: the repository's own flag FV2-06 records that estimator B was fitted on the 2026-11-15 team-stats snapshot and graded on earlier games; no ranking may cite its 13.83 RMSE as out-of-sample. Kept as-is; this audit verifies the arithmetic, not the claim.
